headline: On October 21, 1983: The metre redefined by light
captionCards: Metre defined by light's speed in 1/299,792,458 of a second
Standardized measurements drive global scientific and technological progress
instagramCaption:
The metre got a new definition in 1983. \\[Blank Line] On October 21, 1983, the metre was redefined as the distance light travels in a vacuum in 1/299,792,458 of a second. This change standardized the base unit of length in the International System of Units (SI). Surprisingly, this definition has remained consistent since then, even with further refinements in 2019. The redefinition ensures precise and universal measurement, crucial for scientific and technological advancements. \\[Blank Line] Why is this still important today? \\[Blank Line] Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
